app.subtitle: City of the Watchers
app.tagline: Become an apprentice watcher: Bible stories to learn how to live like Jesus.

setup.heading: How would you like to play?
setup.intro: Choose what helps you. You can change everything later in Settings.

stories.heading: The watcher's missions
stories.intro: In Zion, the watchers look out for one another. Each mission helps you discover a trait of Jesus' character.

where.none: For now, listen to the rest of the story.
where.arrived: You are next to {name}. Press Space to act.

end.reflection: To go further, as a family or a group

settings.heading: Settings
settings.voiceTip: Tip: on iPhone, iPad and Mac you can download very natural "Enhanced" voices for free in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices. On a computer, the Edge browser offers excellent "Natural" voices.
settings.testSentence: Hello! I am the voice of Zion.
settings.noVoice: No voice is installed for this language on this device. Texts are still shown on screen.
settings.appliesNext: This setting will fully apply in the next place.
settings.beacon: Beep showing the direction of the goal (left or right, with headphones)
settings.dataInfo: Your progress is saved only on this device. No account, no data sent anywhere.

help.heading: How to play
help.moveKeys: Arrow keys, or W A S D (Z Q S D)
help.moveTouch: Joystick at the bottom left, or tap the ground
help.actionTouch: Big yellow button at the bottom right
help.tip: No timer, no failing: take all the time you need. The golden diamond shows where to go.
help.creditsText: 3D models: Quaternius (CC0 licence, public domain), via Poly Pizza. Music, sounds, textures and houses: generated in code for Zion. Bible stories retold for children.

errors.webgl: Your device cannot display 3D. Try an up-to-date browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari).

songs.heading: Songs
songs.empty: No songs yet. Add audio files to the project's sounds/ folder.
songs.error: This file can't be played (empty file or unsupported format).

life.heading: Live the mission
life.challenge: The watcher's challenge, for this week
life.acceptedLong: Challenge accepted. It's written in your watcher's notebook.
life.verseHelp: Tap the words in the right order.
life.verseDone: Well done, you know the verse! It's saved in your notebook.
life.goLive: Now close the game and go live your mission!

journal.heading: My watcher's notebook
journal.intro: Your challenges and memories. This notebook stays on your device: nobody else reads it. Here we don't count points: Jesus looks at the heart.
journal.empty: Your notebook is still empty. At the end of a mission, accept the watcher's challenge: it will appear here.
journal.placeholder: For example: I helped my neighbour carry her shopping…
journal.encourage: That's alright. Every day is a new chance. I'm praying for you!

guide.heading: Family time
guide.intro: To live the mission together: at home, at Sunday school or in a group. Play on one screen, then use these questions.
